images.observation: The explicitly labeled tapered source is a crowded near-parallel bundle with broad blade-like bellies and coincident fixed attachment neighborhoods.

The result separates the four colored constructions into distinct radial lanes, but reads as a hard geometric fan; the purple construction has a conspicuous lower-attachment hook and the red construction remains substantially occluded in this view.
Twelve-percent interior crowding increases the numerical overlap while preserving the same compressed source organization and fixed endpoints.

The occupied result is stable under mild crowding and again creates distinct lanes, but the same fan, lower-end hook, broad planar bellies, and scheduled rather than negotiated organization remain visible.
Twenty-four-percent interior crowding visibly tightens the bundle and produces the largest input overlap without moving attachment handles.

The result remains deterministic and separated under moderate crowding, but does not become more anatomically negotiated: it converges to the same hard radial fan and retains the visible attachment hook.

verdict.reason: Absolute belly-role allocation survives baseline, mild, and moderate crowding while preserving endpoints, volume, tangent direction, and pairwise relation direction, but the scheduled angular lanes dominate source morphology and the result remains visibly faceted, hooked, and mechanically arranged.

preserve: baseline, mild, and moderate crowding portfolio
nextAssay.change: Replace absolute radial belly placement with a compact source-frame displacement field whose direction and magnitude vary smoothly along arc length, then make local pairwise and skeletal corrections compete with compactness instead of inheriting a fixed fan.
nextAssay.firstFalsifier: Reject the next mechanism if it cannot retain material overlap reduction across all three conditions while removing the visible lower-attachment hook, materially reducing the fan spread, and keeping endpoint drift, volume error, tangent reversals, and pairwise-relation reversals at zero.
